newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Q Data appoints van der Bijl group chief.
newsitem.headline: Q Data appoints van der Bijl group chief.

text.p: Q Data Ltd said on Wednesday Leen van der Bijl, a founder member and director of the information technology group, has been unanimously appointed chairman and chief executive officer with immediate effect.
This follows after Piet den Boer, the acting chairman, last week left the board. The move prompted Q Data's share price to fall to 850 cents from 914 before. It closed Tuesday at 910 cents.
The appointment of three new board members and two new managing directors of group companies were also announced.

"The Board of Q Data views these appointments as extremely positive developments which will benefit the group in its mission to encourage consultative management, improve operating efficiencies and inculcate good corporate governance practices," the firm said.
